title: Bedhead Attractor
description: The Bedhead Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(x \cdot y/b) \cdot y + cos(a \cdot x - y), y_{n+1} = x + sin(y)/b

title: Bedhead Attractor 3D
description: 3D Bedhead discrete map (warm amber points): same x/y as 2D plus z_{n+1}=y+cos(yx)/b. Archive defaults a=0.13, b=0.37; transport n scrubs iterate count. 2D stage remains at bedhead_attractor.

title: Bogdanov Map
description: The Bogdanov Map (Rifkat Bogdanov) is the discrete map y' = y + a y + b x(x-1) + \mu x y, x' = x + y' with defaults a=0.0025, b=1.44, \mu=-0.1.

title: Brusselator (ODE)
description: Well-mixed Brusselator ODEs drawn as a phase-orbit trail (Euler step): dx/dt = a-(b+1)x+x^2 y, dy/dt = bx-x^2 y. Not a spatial reaction–diffusion field.

title: Brusselator RD
description: Spatial Brusselator reaction–diffusion on a grid (Neumann borders): spots/stripes from Du∇²u + a-(b+1)u+u²v and Dv∇²v + bu-u²v. Distinct from the ODE phase-orbit page.

title: Clifford Attractor
description: The Clifford Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(a \cdot y_n) + c \cdot cos(a \cdot x_n), y_{n+1} = sin(b \cdot x_n) + d \cdot cos(b \cdot y_n)

title: Peter de Jong Attractor
description: 2D Peter de Jong iterated map: x′=sin(a y)−cos(b x), y′=sin(c x)−cos(d y). Archive defaults a=2.695, b=1.72, c=1.178, d=0.311.

title: Fractal Dream Attractor
description: The Fractal Dream Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(y_n \cdot b) + c \cdot sin(x_n \cdot b), y_{n+1} = sin(x_n \cdot a) + d \cdot sin(y_n \cdot a)

title: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
description: Gumowski–Mira attractor: x' = y + a(1-b y²)y + G(x,μ), y' = -x + G(x',μ), with G(x,μ)=μx + 2(1-μ)x²/(1+x²).

title: Henon Map
description: Classic Hénon map (1976): x' = 1 - a x² + y, y' = b x. Defaults a=1.4, b=0.3.

title: Hopalong Attractor
description: Barry Martin's classic Hopalong (1981): x' = y - sgn(x)√|b x - c|, y' = a - x. Defaults a=1.4, b≈5.16, c≈2.74.

title: Hopalong Attractor Positive
description: Martin positive Hopalong: x' = y + sgn(x)√|b x - c|, y' = a - x. Same a,b,c knobs as classic.

title: Hopalong Attractor Additive
description: Martin additive Hopalong: x' = y + √|b x - c|, y' = a - x (no sign flip). Same a,b,c knobs as classic.

title: Hopalong Attractor Sinusoidal
description: Martin sinusoidal Hopalong: x' = y + sin(b x - c), y' = a - x. Defaults a=2.5, b=4, c=0.2 (chaotic fill; small b stays ring-like).

title: Hopalong Attractor 1
description: Archive Hopalong typo variant: classic-shaped map with sin(x−1) instead of sign(x−1), and |b x − 1 − c| under the square root.

title: Gingerbread Man
description: The Gingerbread Man (or Gingerbreadman) map is a chaotic 2D system defined by x_{n+1} = 1 - y_n + |x_n|, y_{n+1} = x_n. Its orbit often resembles a gingerbread figure.

title: Ikeda Map
description: Ikeda map (param a): f = 0.4 - 6/(1+x²+y²), x' = 1 + a(x cos f − y sin f), y' = a(x sin f + y cos f).

title: Lorenz Attractor
description: Classic 3D Lorenz system rendered as a GPU line trail (green→white): dx/dt = σ(y-x), dy/dt = x(ρ-z)-y, dz/dt = xy-βz with σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3.

title: Lorenz 86 Attractor
description: 3D Lorenz 86 ODE trail (cool→warm): mid-1980s low-order atmosphere model, distinct from classic 1963 Lorenz. Knobs a,b,f,g and step d; coeffs a=1.111, b=4.494, f=1.479, g=0.44; default d=0.015 (archive preset d=0.13).

title: Aizawa Attractor
description: 3D Aizawa ODE trail (cool→warm): round shell with a funnel through the axis. Knobs a–f and dt; archive-style defaults a=0.95, b=0.7, c=0.6, d=3.5, e=0.25, f=0.1, dt=0.01.

title: Halvorsen Attractor
description: 3D Halvorsen ODE trail (cool→warm): cyclically symmetric chaos with single knob a. Defaults a=1.4, dt=0.01, seed (−5,0,0).

title: Mandelbrot Set
description: The Mandelbrot Set is defined by iterating z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c for complex c; the set is those c for which the sequence remains bounded.

title: Julia Set
description: Julia sets fix a complex constant c and iterate z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c over starting points z₀. Each c yields a different connected or dusty fractal.

title: Sierpiński Triangle
description: GPU Sierpiński gasket with scroll-zoom and drag-pan. Each pixel tests barycentric membership through recursive corner remaps until a void or max depth. Depth is screen-capped to avoid sparkles.

title: Hilbert Curve
description: 2D Hilbert space-filling curve: Hilbert index i maps to a cell on an N×N grid (N=2^order) via bit-twiddle hindex2xy; particles grow along the path. Default order 7 (N=128).

title: Calabi–Yau Manifold
description: Hanson 3D projection of a 2-real slice of the Fermat quintic as a particle wire. Morph degree n and projection angle a; not the full 6-real Calabi–Yau 3-fold.

title: Gyroid
description: Schoen gyroid as a particle wire: triply periodic minimal surface from sin x cos y + sin y cos z + sin z cos x = t on a 2π cell.

title: Barth Sextic
description: Barth’s degree-6 icosahedral surface as a particle wire. Morph tau (golden lattice), radius (sphere term), mix (spikes vs shell).

title: Schwarz P
description: Schwarz primitive (P) as a particle wire. Morph iso-level t and tiles on the cos x + cos y + cos z = t labyrinth.

title: Svensson Attractor
description: The Svensson Attractor is a 2D chaotic map: x_{n+1} = d \cdot sin(a \cdot x_n) - sin(b \cdot y_n), y_{n+1} = c \cdot cos(a \cdot x_n) + cos(b \cdot y_n) with defaults a=-3, b=3, c=3, d=3, seed (0,0).

title: Dini's Surface
description: Dini’s surface: a pseudospherical helicoid (twisted tractrix). UV isoline particle wire with radius a and twist b.

title: Roman Surface
description: Steiner’s Roman surface: RP² immersion as a UV isoline particle wire. Morph squash stretches z before normalize.

title: Enneper Surface
description: Enneper’s minimal surface as a UV isoline particle wire. Span sets |u|,|v| so the self-intersections read.

title: Boy's Surface
description: Immersion of RP² in R³ as a polar isoline wire. Morph k: Roman→Apéry Boy; bryant: Apéry→Bryant–Kusner three-balls.

title: Thomas Attractor
description: 3D Thomas cyclically symmetric ODE trail (cool→warm): labyrinth chaos with knob b. Defaults b=0.19, dt=0.01, seed (0.1,0,0).

title: Clebsch Cubic
description: Clebsch’s diagonal cubic as a lit triangle mesh: the smooth degree-3 surface where all 27 lines are real.

title: Svensson Attractor (3D)
description: Modified 3D Svensson map trail: x'=d sin(a x)-sin(b y), y'=c cos(a x)+cos(b y), z'=e sin(a x)+sin(b y). Defaults a=-3, b=c=d=e=3.

title: Perlin Noise
description: Ken Perlin’s improved 2D gradient noise as a GPU field. Morph scale, octaves (fBm), and drift speed; hue from the noise value.

title: Hopf Fibration
description: Stereographic Hopf fibers: linked circles from the map S³ → S². Morph fiber count and stereo strength.

title: Peter de Jong Attractor (3D)
description: 3D Peter de Jong discrete map trail (rose→gold): x′=sin(a z)−cos(b x), y′=sin(c x)−cos(d y), z′=sin(e y)−cos(f z). Archive defaults a=2.695, b=1.72, c=1.178, d=0.311, e=−1, f=−1.

title: Costa Surface
description: Costa–Hoffman–Meeks genus-1 complete minimal surface as a truncated lit mesh. Margin cuts the three ends on the square torus.

title: Figure Knots
description: Torus-knot-style parametric curve as a particle wire. Morph tube radius a and frequencies b, c, d.

title: Modified Chua Attractor
description: 3D Modified Chua multi-scroll ODE trail: h=-b sin(πx/(2a)+d), ẋ=α(y−h), ẏ=x−y+z, ż=−βy. Archive coeffs α=10.82, β=14.286, a=1.3, b=0.11, d=2.981; default dt=0.02 (archive point cloud used 0.1).

title: Polynomial ABS
description: 3D absolute-value polynomial map trail: each axis mixes x,y,z and |x|,|y|,|z| with seven coeffs (xa…zg). Archive defaults; cool→warm line trail.

title: Polynomial Type A
description: 3D polynomial Type A map: x'=a+y−zy, y'=b+z−xz, z'=c+x−yx. Archive defaults a=1.586, b=1.124, c=0.281; cool→warm trail.

title: Polynomial Type B
description: 3D polynomial Type B map with six scale knobs on cyclic product terms. Archive index.js defaults a=1.6691, b=1.0405, c=0.2818, d=0.2818, e=0, f=1.1055; cool→warm trail.

title: Polynomial Type C
description: 3D per-axis quadratic polynomial map (six coeffs per axis, xa…zf). Archive defaults; cool→warm GPU line trail.
